title: 第一章 被爹献祭给邪修第二章 大胖没有抛弃我
slug: 被弃龙崽崽三界仙兽都是我喂哒
lines: 囚笼界各处充斥着暴乱的灵力，乱葬岗更是聚集阴、邪、煞、魔气的无人区。
道上，四岁半的玄稷被爹抱着，快速赶往乱葬岗。
半路被颠簸醒的玄稷揉了揉眼睛，看着外面一片漆黑疑惑出声。
“爹爹带我去哪啊？”
自己不是刚在草窝里跟大胖一起睡下了吗？
同时反应过来现在正被爹爹抱着，玄稷的小心灵很是激动。
爹爹一直都是只抱着妹妹的，还是第一次抱自己呢！
玄稷因为开心，都不怕周围的漆黑了。
周自珩没想到玄稷竟然醒了，嫌恶且粗鲁地把她扔下的。
“既然醒了，就自己走吧！”
被放下的差点摔跤的玄稷，忙极力稳住身形。
心里有点懊恼。
自己刚才就不应该出声的。
那样就可以被爹爹多抱一会儿了。
离开了爹爹的怀抱，奋力跑着才能跟上爹爹的脚步。
小手偷偷拉住爹爹裤腿。
生怕自己下一刻跟不上就被丢下了。
“爹爹，我们这是去哪呀？
娘和妹妹呢？”
周自珩有些不耐烦，想到他是带着这小野种给亲女儿换修炼机缘的，勉为其难跟她说两句。
“我带你去个好地方，你以后都不用再过这样的苦日子了。”
让她免于在现在这样无法正常修炼，又邪魔妖乱的乱世挣扎，怎么不是好地方呢！
玄稷根本不知道将要迎接自己的是什么，听爹说得很是高兴。
“真的吗？
只有我和爹爹吗？
那娘和妹妹不来吗？”
还有大胖呢？
不过她并不敢把大胖说出来。
她听爹和娘说过，到现在还养着大胖，就是为了在没吃的时候，把大胖杀了吃狗肉的。
“闭嘴！”
周自珩不耐烦应付玄稷。
玄稷见爹发怒了，吓得再不敢吱声，同时心里有点紧张，总感觉好像有什么不好的事要发生似的。
小小的玄稷对时间还不是很有概念，只知道自己走得脚也疼了腿也酸了，终于停下来了。
就是这里实在是太臭了。
但爹没开口她也不敢吱声。
“仙师，人已带到，还请仙师笑纳！”
周自珩对着乱葬岗深处作揖恭恭敬敬禀道。
玄稷看着前面明明漆黑一片，什么人也没有，爹是在跟谁说话？
content_en:
Everywhere in the Cage World is filled with rioting spiritual energy, and the mass graves are a no-man's land where Yin, evil, evil, and demonic energy gather.
On the road, four-and-a-half-year-old Xuan Ji was held by his father and rushed to the mass grave.
Xuan Ji, who was woken up by a jolt on the way, rubbed his eyes and looked at the darkness outside, making a sound of confusion.
"Where are you taking me, daddy?"
Didn't he just sleep with the fat man in the grass nest?
At the same time, when he realized that he was being held by his father, Xuan Ji's little heart was very excited.
Dad always only holds his sister, but this is the first time he holds himself!
Because Xuan Ji was happy, he was no longer afraid of the darkness around him.
Zhou Ziheng didn't expect Xuan Ji to wake up, and threw her down rudely and disgustedly.
"Now that you're awake, just leave by yourself!"
Xuan Ji, who almost fell after being put down, tried his best to stabilize his body.
I felt a little annoyed.
I shouldn't have spoken out just now.
That way I can be held by daddy for a little longer.
I left my father's arms and ran hard to keep up with him.
My little hand secretly grabbed daddy's trouser leg.
I was afraid that I would be left behind if I couldn’t keep up the next moment.
"Dad, where are we going?
Where are your mother and sister? "
Zhou Ziheng was a little impatient, thinking that he was bringing this little bastard to give his own daughter a chance to practice, so he reluctantly said a few words to her.
"I'll take you to a good place, and you won't have to live such a hard life in the future."
Why wouldn't it be a good place to save her from struggling in this troubled world where she is unable to practice normally and is plagued by demons and monsters?
Xuan Ji had no idea what was about to greet him, so he was very happy to hear what his father said.
"Really?
Is it just me and daddy?
Aren't your mother and sister coming? "
And what about Big Fat?
But she didn't dare to tell Big Fatty.
She heard her father and mother say that they still keep Big Fat just to kill those who eat dog meat when they don’t have anything to eat.
"Shut up!"
Zhou Ziheng was impatient to deal with Xuan Ji.
Seeing that his father was angry, Xuan Ji was so frightened that he dared not say a word. At the same time, he felt a little nervous, as if something bad was about to happen.
The little Xuan Ji didn't have a good idea of ​​time. He only knew that his feet hurt and his legs were sore from walking, so he finally stopped.
It just stinks so much here.
But she didn't dare to say anything when her father didn't speak.
"Immortal Master, I have brought you here, please accept it with your smile!"
Zhou Ziheng bowed to the depths of the mass grave and said respectfully.
Xuan Ji looked at the front. It was completely dark and there was no one. Who was dad talking to?
title_en: Chapter 1: Being sacrificed by my father to the evil cultivator Chapter 2: Big Fat didn’t abandon me
